items.prompt: Use case: illustration-story. Asset type: a single finished static opening illustration for the individual Air Screamer story in the fan game Silent Hill: Halo of Flesh. This is a new original composition, strictly based on Silent Hill (1999) visual references, not a scene from a remake or the movie. Image 1 is the native SH1 Air Screamer identity reference: preserve its very long broad leathery wings, narrow down-curved elongated head, compact brown mottled torso, two dangling legs and proportions; no horns, feathers, extra arms, rider or new powers. Image 2 is the native Levin Street house reference: blue-grey worn timber siding, low concrete porch steps, gabled small doghouse and weathered rural mailbox, grey fog and white snow flecks. Image 3 is the game's existing adaptation of that exact frontage and supplies the spatial continuity and muted painterly realism, not independent lore evidence. Create a polished wide 16:9 cinematic landscape, with the camera near street level looking towards this same house frontage. One complete Air Screamer crosses low above the empty roadway, slightly left of centre, in the same nearly frontal extended-wing pose as image 1; show its whole body and both full wing tips with generous breathing room. Keep the house, doghouse, mailbox and steps recognizable behind it, in their image-3 arrangement. Atmospheric grey daylight, original SH1 snow rather than film ash, subdued colours with readable leathery texture. The creature should fill roughly the central half of the width; preserve quiet space and do not turn it into a giant dragon. No humans, no other monsters, no fight contact, no gore, no UI, no text, no logos, no border, no watermark. Opaque full background, one illustration, no contact sheet or panels. Keep the characteristic SH1 silhouette more important than decorative detail.

Use case: illustration-story / precise-object-edit. Asset type: the single static ending illustration paired with this opening in the individual Air Screamer story, Silent Hill (1999). Edit the supplied opening image to show the same Levin Street frontage immediately after the creature has left. Remove the one Air Screamer completely and reconstruct only the small areas it covered using the surrounding siding, window and mist. Preserve the exact camera, 16:9 composition, house silhouettes, doghouse, mailbox, both porch stairs, ground, roof, snow and subdued grey palette. The street is empty and the same grey fog persists. No human, no other creature, no wing fragment, no blood or remains, no new object or symbol, no sunbeam or cheerful weather. The absence of the creature is the narrative change. Keep the native resolution and texture quality, with all architectural relationships unchanged. Opaque background. No text, UI, logo, border or watermark. One landscape illustration, not panels.
